title: hs_customer_agent_lead_status became read-only on 2026-07-13
summary: Since 2026-07-13 the contact property hs_customer_agent_lead_status is system-managed by Customer Agent and read-only; writes to it from the CRM Objects APIs, apps, workflows or imports fail with an error. Reads keep working. The notice names no paths; the contacts object path here is where CRM Objects API writes go.
migrationNote: Remove hs_customer_agent_lead_status from contact create/update/batch payloads; write your own lead status to a custom contact property instead, and if you need Customer Agent's value, read hs_customer_agent_lead_status and copy it into that custom property.
